title: bodySnippet over unencrypted channels should be MUST NOT not SHOULD NOT
description: §8.1 says 'Servers SHOULD NOT deliver bodySnippet content over unencrypted push channels.' The same section establishes a MUST NOT against including ciphertext in snippets (§6). Delivering plaintext message content over an unencrypted channel is a privacy violation; the normative strength should be MUST NOT, or the weaker level needs an explicit justification.
close_reason: Decision: keep SHOULD NOT. Server may not have reliable visibility into push channel transport; MUST NOT would be unimplementable for servers using third-party push relays.
